messages.subject: Updated developer process doc for stan-dev/stan
parts:
Bob updated the developer process a bit.
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Developer-Process


Key changes:
- branch naming convention
- origin branch
- bugfix branches.

Since we're fixing so many bugs and working on new features, we really want separate them. Bug fixes will start from the latest hotfix branch and be pushed back into that branch.

Feature branches will start from develop and be merged back there.



Daniel
